notes: Applies to the Roughneck AI V2000 / Roughneck V2100 lines (V2002/V2005/V2008 bullet, dome, micro dome, box, LPR, corner, V-CELL, V2360W fisheye, V2105) and the V2000D-PTZ and V2008PTZ-IR PTZ domes: default RTSP port 554, stream URL names stream1 / stream2 / stream3. The names are editable in the camera web UI (Network > RTSP), so a reconfigured camera may differ. Lines with other documented paths carry their own URL on the camera record: V940 series (V942/V944/V945 bullet and dome) use /ch1/stream1, /ch1/stream2, /ch1/stream3 (V940B/V940D/V945B/V945D manuals); the V2020/V2032-WIR-360 multi-sensor uses one path per sensor, /stream1_1 to /stream1_4 (primary) and /stream2_1 to /stream2_4 (secondary) (Multi-Sensor 360 User Manual). The V800B, V930D, V9501D, V980B/V980D, V8360W and V9360 user manuals document only the RTSP port (554), not the stream path — use ONVIF discovery on those models.
